intent.description: Classification of the user input. Use 'BROWSER_TASK' for web navigation, searching, clicking, scraping, opening URLs, or interacting with web applications. Use 'FILESYSTEM_TASK' for operations involving files or directories such as listing, searching, reading, writing, editing, creating, moving, copying, deleting, or analyzing local sandbox files. Use 'CHAT' for conversational, informational, coding, reasoning, or writing requests that do not require browser or filesystem execution.

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of why this intent was selected.

task_description.description: Cleaned up task description for the browser agent if intent is BROWSER_TASK, else empty.
